# AniStream v2.1.2

No more ad pop-ups from the movie and show players, keyboard controls that keep working, and a
quicker way to the next episode.

## Better

- ⚡️ Next episode from the ending: While an episode's ending plays, the Skip button becomes
  **Next episode** and starts it straight away. This works in AniStream's own player and over the
  main anime player
- ⚡️ Players take the keyboard as soon as they start, so **Space** and the arrow keys work without
  clicking the video first (in players that support them)

## Fixed

- 🔒 Players in Movies & TV could open ads in your web browser after a few clicks (#38)
- 🦺 In AniStream's own player, keyboard shortcuts stopped working after clicking one of its
  buttons or sliders (#38)
- 🦺 Pressing **Space** right after a player opened went back to the title page instead
- 🦺 Pressing **Escape** to close the own player's settings menu also closed the player
- 🦺 The **X** to remove a show from Continue Watching in Anime didn't appear

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.1.2-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.1.2.exe`: Windows x64

On Windows, AniStream downloads this update in the background and installs it when you choose
**Restart to update**. You can also install over your existing copy; your data and AniList session
are kept. macOS links to this release page.

Both packages are unsigned. On Windows, select **More info → Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns
you. On macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after the first
launch. Each download can be checked against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
